origin: Root origin is socket_grip_r; source axes are normalized to Blender +Z up/-Y forward so Blender export_yup produces runtime Y-up/+Z-forward sockets.

socket_notes.socket_muzzle: Center of actual foremost barrel ring, raw max Z within0.1mm; measured raw(.0631760526,.0177737572,.2159179002)m.
socket_notes.socket_grip_r: Actual upper pistol handle, raw(-.02,.0177960826,-.025)m, midpoint of independently intersected left/right side surfaces.
socket_notes.socket_grip_l: Actual opposite grip side surface, raw(-.012,0.0014656925,-.005)m. Two-handed pistol support stays near primary firing grip, away from muzzle.
socket_notes.socket_eject: Legacy provisional proposal; actual port and ejection direction remain unaccepted. No slide/magazine motion frames are authored.
socket_notes.socket_vfx: Muzzle flash/tracer fallback, intentionally colocated with socket_muzzle.
